Dear Madam,
I am much obliged by your kind answer and will write again in a short time. Another application that I had made about ten days before and had begun to think was unnoticed, has at length answered me, and I must know first whether the girl is eligible to the school that has been mentioned to me.
When this is decided I will write again
With many thanks

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
